identity_resolution.independence_rationale: The dataset name and Taqrib entry 1650 match the lineage خالد بن عبد الرحمن بن بكير; the entry also matches the dataset's أبو أمية, السلمي، البصري, and eighth-generation metadata. Al-Mizzi's Tahdhib entry 1628 also records the same lineage, al-Sulami nisbah, kunya, and Basran association. The adjacent Taqrib entry 1652 is a distinct al-Makhzumi al-Makki with a different lineage and generation. The grade is excluded from identity resolution. These matches do not establish the dataset's source route or literary independence between the works.
